newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Timberland shares rise.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Timberland shares rise.

text.p: Timberland Co's shares rose four percent Wednesday as investors apparently established new positions after taking profits on the shares last week.

Last week, Timberland reported earnings of $557,000, or $0.05 a share, in the second quarter, its first profitable second quarter since 1994, said Jonathan Chappell of Value Line Inc. Last year, the company lost $6.9 million, or $0.61 a share, during the second quarter.
The strong results triggered selling by profit takers, he said. This week, investors appear to be taking new positions in the shares.
"It's been going up since last August or September," Chappell said of Timberland's stock. The company is "performing really well," he added.
